# MDL903 · `table-schema-template`

<!-- Generated by tools/gendocs from internal/rules: do not edit. -->

A table section names another database than the template.

| | |
|---|---|
| Family | conventions |
| Default severity | error |
| Fix | — |

## Why

A table section copied from another configuration keeps masking or filtering a database this file does not dump. The rule does nothing unless the `conventions` section of the configuration sets it up.

## Example

❌ Before:

```ini
[`hr`.`people`]
where=1
```

```text
1:2-1:15 error MDL903[table-schema-template] the table section is in database "hr", not "sales"
```

## Configuration

Enabled by default. To change its severity or turn it off:

```yaml
rules:
  severity:
    MDL903: warning   # or error, info, off
```

To accept one occurrence, put `# mydumper-lint: disable-next-line=MDL903` on the line above it.
